verdict.rationale: 2FAS is local-first with end-to-end encryption, no telemetry, and vendor has no access to plaintext vault/token data (docs-9, docs-26, docs-29, probe-rt-2 'no telemetry'), which structurally prevents user data from being harvested for AI training — but there is no explicit policy statement addressing AI model training use of data. missing for 10: explicit AI-training opt-out/data-usage policy, any statement about third-party AI processing of user content, independent audit confirming no data leaves device for AI purposes.
